method: Linear trend + blocker recurrence analysis over available cycle data (c12-c18)

historical_trend.note: Cycles 12-16 show 0-15% (early infrastructure building). Cycles 17-18 show 86% (infrastructure matured). The jump is structural, not linear - fleet crossed a capability threshold.
historical_trend.note_interventions: Stable at 1-3 per cycle. No upward trend. Types: approve (4), unblock (3), redirect (3). All are direction-setting, not failure-recovery.

rationale: Completion rate stable at 86% across c17-c18 (no decay signal)
Intervention rate flat (not increasing) - agents not escalating more
Autonomy score 71.3 is below 85 threshold but trending up (was ~50 in c12 era)
No new blocker classes in last cycle (RC3 regression check passed since initial FAIL was resolved)
Knowledge infrastructure mature: pointer maps, evidence chains, ledger all operational
conditions_for_holding: No host failures exceeding 2h recovery time
No new blocker class emerges (monitor blockers.md)
Model load success rate >= 90% across fleet

highest_risk_regression_vectors.detail: Designer at 9/10 with 1 goal open; Designer seat was unreachable this cycle. If the remaining goal requires human input on creative direction, it could stall indefinitely.
highest_risk_regression_vectors.mitigation: Scribe or Archivist can assist if blocked > 2 cycles

highest_risk_regression_vectors.detail: Scribe has 0/10 reached in current cycle file. All 5 goals are analytical/reporting tasks that depend on data from other lanes. If upstream data quality degrades, Scribe cannot complete.
highest_risk_regression_vectors.mitigation: Goals are self-contained enough to proceed with available data

highest_risk_regression_vectors.detail: Multiple seats relocated to White (local) this cycle. If White becomes overloaded or fails, cascade of relocations could disrupt 4+ agents simultaneously.
highest_risk_regression_vectors.mitigation: Red now powered on - provides recovery path. Mechanic monitors VRAM.

highest_risk_regression_vectors.detail: Cycle 18 goals are well-scoped but cycle 19 may introduce broader cross-lane goals that increase coordination overhead.
highest_risk_regression_vectors.mitigation: Convergence lock protocol requires zero new blockers - scope creep would surface as new blocker classes

forecast_summary: Fleet is in a structurally stable convergence phase. The 86% completion rate is sustainable for >= 3 cycles (confidence 72%). Primary risk is not decay but stagnation: Scribe and Designer lanes may plateau without new data inputs or creative direction. Autonomy score gap (71.3 vs 85) will close as intervention patterns normalize and the fleet accumulates more autonomous cycle completions. ETA to steady-state: ~4-6 cycles at current trajectory.
